component.name: Resolve Ready
component.summary: Convert video into formats DaVinci Resolve can edit on Linux

description.p: Resolve Ready prepares camera footage for DaVinci Resolve on Linux. Resolve Free cannot decode H.264, H.265 or AAC, so this app transcodes video to DNxHR or ProRes and audio to 24-bit PCM at 48 kHz.
Every output is verified against its source. Originals are kept.
Fixes magenta/green color bars in 8-bit DNxHR output from the AppImage.
Rebuilds the bundled FFmpeg with x86 assembly enabled.
Updates the application ID and maintainer identity to mdshakibsami.
Removes the placeholder support link until a real URL is available.
Clarifies the tested Ubuntu and Debian releases.
Adds a self-contained AppImage build and a universal .deb package.
Tested on Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 and Debian 12 and 13.
